search_window.basis: Prior hourly check approximately 10:43 PT; newly reported U.S. disruptions, with broader indexed results screened for actual publication dates.

coverage_notes.role: Supplementary high-value recall watch only; production collector remains authoritative.

Abrupt food pantry/bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food assistance service interruption
coverage_notes.evaluation: No source dated within the bounded interval substantiated a qualifying new disruption. Search results were older incidents, routine schedules/notices, foreign locations, or closures without sole/full-service grocery loss.
examples_excluded: Spencer, NY sole-grocer fire previously reported in September 2026
Arvada, CO Safeway closure notice dated October 14; nearby grocers remain
